descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Paris puts you in the captain's seat over the real Paris.

THE REAL PARIS
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, the Arc de Triomphe, the Louvre and its pyramid, the Invalides' golden dome, Sacre-Coeur, the Grand Palais, the Pantheon, La Defense, the Stade de France, Versailles and its Grand Canal. Charles de Gaulle, Orly, Le Bourget and Toussus.

THROUGH THE EIFFEL TOWER
Dive off the Trocadero, cross the Seine and fly between the legs of the tower, under the first floor.

THE SEINE
29 real bridges, from the Pont Neuf to the Pont Alexandre III. Bateaux-mouches on the river, the metro over the Pont de Bir-Hakeim.

THE CITY OF LIGHT
At night the tower glows gold and sparkles, and the Champs-Elysees becomes a river of lights.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance.

ENGLISH AND FRENCH
Switch every menu between English and French in Settings.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Champ de Mars, the Eiffel Tower filling the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
Orly over the city, the Seine run, through the Eiffel Tower, Versailles and the chateaux, a fighter scramble from Le Bourget, the city of light and a Paris tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
